Workflows.title: Initiate Digital Mortgage Application
Workflows.goal: Verify the entry point for the digital mortgage application is functional.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il
2. Click the 'בואו נתחיל' button
3. Verify redirection to the external FormTitan application (https://leumimortgage.formtitan.com/ftproject/mortgagerequest)
agent_activity_summary: The agent navigated to the Leumi mortgage homepage and clicked the 'בואו נתחיל' button to initiate the digital mortgage application. However, instead of being redirected to the expected external FormTitan application, the agent was taken to an internal minisite page. The agent attempted to retry the process by navigating back and clicking the button again, but encountered the same result and ultimately terminated the workflow.
agent_activity_error: In Step 2, after clicking the 'בואו נתחיל' button, the agent was redirected to 'https://mortgage.leumi.co.il/minisite/mortgage' instead of the expected FormTitan URL. The agent attempted to recover in Step 4 by navigating back to the homepage and retrying the click action in Step 5. When the same incorrect redirection occurred, the agent reported a failure and terminated the workflow in Step 6.
agent_activity_outcome: The agent failed to achieve the final goal. While it successfully located and clicked the start button, the application redirected to an unexpected internal page rather than the external FormTitan application.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate the routing and redirection logic for the 'בואו נתחיל' button on the homepage to ensure it correctly points to the external FormTitan application (https://leumimortgage.formtitan.com/ftproject/mortgagerequest). If the application flow has intentionally changed to include an intermediate minisite page, update the test scenario to reflect the new expected behavior.
test_steps: Navigate to homepage: Load the Leumi mortgage homepage
Click Start Button: Click the 'Let's start' button to initiate the application

Workflows.title: Access Mortgage Calculator
Workflows.goal: Open the mortgage calculator tool. Success: New tab opens with the calculator URL.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il
2. Click on 'מחשבון משכנתא'
3. Verify a new tab opens navigating to the calculator (https://ufapi.bankleumi.co.il/mortgageCalculator/Calc)

Workflows.title: Browse Real Estate Projects
Workflows.goal: Filter and view details of a specific real estate project. Success: Project details page loads successfully.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il
2. Click on 'פרויקטי נדל"ן' in the navigation menu
3. Check the location filter checkbox for 'מרכז'
4. Click on a specific project link from the results (e.g., 'גיא ודורון לוי- GD PREMIUM COLLECTION C')
5. Verify the project details and benefits are displayed

Workflows.title: Search for Documents and Forms
Workflows.goal: Use the site search to find and navigate to the forms page. Success: Navigated to the forms page.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il
2. Click on the search icon ('חיפוש')
3. Enter 'טפסים' into the search input field
4. Click the search submit button
5. Click on the search result 'מסמכים וטפסים נפוצים'
6. Verify navigation to the forms page

Workflows.title: Request a Call via Contact Widget
Workflows.goal: Open the contact widget and initiate a call request. Success: Contact menu opens and call request link opens a new tab.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il
2. Click the chat widget at the bottom left ('היי ! אנחנו כאן לכל שאלה')
3. Click the 'הזמנת שיחה' link
4. Verify a new tab opens for the call request form
